title: Demonic Path Movements
next_chapter_hook: When Ye Qing's figure vanished into the night, Chen Ji tightened his grip on the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand—he knew that time was running out.

text.content:
The night of the imperial capital was darker than Chen Ji had imagined.

The massive city walls cast enormous shadows under the moonlight, like a crouching beast. The air was filled with an indescribable aura—power, conspiracy, the wails of countless wronged souls. The moment Chen Ji stepped through the city gate, he felt a faint gaze sweep over him.

That gaze was cold, sharp, carrying a condescending scrutiny.

He didn't look back, only lowering his hat brim slightly as his footsteps carried him steadily into the city. The lanterns on both sides of the street cast a dim yellow glow, stretching his shadow long and faint.

He knew he was being watched.

From the very first second he entered the imperial capital, that gaze had followed him like a shadow. It wasn't from any single person, but from every corner of the city—the guards on the walls, the guests in the taverns, even the beggars on the roadside could all be part of those eyes.

The three great sects had eyes everywhere in the imperial capital—this was something Chen Ji had long anticipated. But what truly concerned him was something else—

That gaze carried a certain... familiarity.

Like an invisible thread was connecting him with some distant existence.

"You came."

A voice sounded beside his ear, soft, cold, with a hint of mockery. Chen Ji's footsteps didn't pause, but as he passed a narrow alley, he sidestepped into it.

In the depths of the alley, a figure leaned against the wall waiting for him.

The black silk robe fluttered gently in the night wind, revealing a face so delicate it was almost uncanny. Those eyes gleamed with a faint green light in the darkness, like will-o'-the-wisps in the deep night.

Ye Qing.

The Holy Sect Saint of the Demonic Path, yet appearing like an ordinary intelligence dealer in the dark alley of the Great Chen Imperial Capital.

dialogue.content: "Good news and bad news, which do you want to hear first?" Ye Qing's voice carried a hint of playfulness, but the bottom of her eyes held an irrepressible gravity. She took out a Jade Slip from her sleeve and casually tossed it to Chen Ji, "The good news is, your 'useless persona' act was quite convincing—at least nine out of ten people in the Tianqing Sect were fooled. The bad news..." She paused, a meaningful smile curving at the corner of her lips, "The Demonic Path Commander already knows your true identity."

text.content:
Chen Ji caught the Jade Slip, his divine sense gently probing within. The next moment, his pupils slightly contracted.

The Jade Slip recorded an extremely secret piece of information—an ancient concept circulating within the Holy Sect: Destined Twins.

The so-called Destined Twins referred to two beings chosen by the Heavenly Dao, sharing the same strand of fate but walking completely opposite paths. When one rises, the other necessarily falls. And when one dies, the other will inherit its entire Heavenly Fate.

Chen Ji stared at this passage, his mind racing at high speed.

Was he and the Demonic Path Commander... Destined Twins?

dialogue.content: "The secret agents you planted within the Holy Sect," Ye Qing's voice turned low, "although destroyed, actually made the Commander confirm one thing—you could never be some useless disciple. A useless disciple would never possess that kind of strategic layout ability." Her gaze tightly fixed on Chen Ji's face, seemingly wanting to detect some flaw, "The Commander said you are the one he has waited three hundred years for. He wants me to deliver you a message—'The chess game is over, the chess piece should return to its position.'"

text.content:
The alley was terrifyingly quiet.

Chen Ji's fingers gripping the Jade Slip tightened slightly, but his expression remained unruffled. He tucked the Jade Slip into his sleeve, looked up at Ye Qing, even a faint smile curving at the corner of his mouth.

"Three hundred years of waiting," his voice was light, but carried an indescribable irony, "looks like this Commander is quite sentimental. But I'm curious—how does he plan to 'invite' me back? Cross-realm pursuit? With his cultivation, it shouldn't be strong enough for that, right?"

A flicker of异样 crossed Ye Qing's eyes.

dialogue.content:
"If it was just cross-realm pursuit, would I need to come give you the news in the middle of the night?" Ye Qing's voice suddenly dropped, carrying a tension even she wasn't aware of, "The Commander has already opened the seal of the 'Fate Altar'. In three days, he will hold a sacrifice ceremony—at that time, he can briefly obtain the gaze right of the 'Heavenly Dao's Eye'. Do you know what this means?"

Her gaze fixed directly on Chen Ji, each word precise: "At that time, he can lock onto your location in any corner of this world. And your Tianji Record's aura... will have nowhere to hide."

text.content:
The air seemed to freeze.

Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly, but in his heart, waves were churning. The gaze right of the Heavenly Dao's Eye... what this meant, he knew better than anyone.

That wasn't just a tracking method; it was a 'mark' from the Heavenly Dao's level. Once marked, no matter where he fled, no matter how he hid, the Heavenly Dao's Eye would be like a sword hanging over his head, ready to behead him at any moment.

And what concerned him more was another piece of information in Ye Qing's words—

The Demonic Path Commander seemed to have some connection with the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing brought extremely dangerous intelligence: the Demonic Path Commander not only knew Chen Ji's true identity but also planned to use the Fate Altar to obtain the gaze right of the Heavenly Dao's Eye in three days. This meant Chen Ji's fake death plan had to be adjusted immediately, otherwise he would have nowhere to escape in three days. Faced with this crisis, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Initiate an attack, destroy the Fate Altar
choices.description: Better to strike first than wait to be hunted. Three days is enough for him to lay out a surprise attack and destroy the altar's core formation.
choices.visible_cost: Expose some strength, may alert the enemy
choices.visible_reward: Completely dismantle the Demonic Path Commander's pursuit plan
choices.risk_hint: The heart of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, extremely dangerous

text.content:
Upon hearing this, a flash of astonishment crossed Ye Qing's eyes. She hadn't expected this 'useless disciple' to think about counterattacking after hearing such shocking news.

"You've gone mad?" Her voice carried a barely concealable tremor, "The Fate Altar is in the core of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, surrounded by at least three layers of mountain protection formations and twelve Transformed God realm elders guarding it. If you go alone, that's just seeking death!"

dialogue.content: But Ye Qing also knew Chen Ji never did anything without certainty. She took a deep breath, suppressing the shock in her heart, and said coldly, "What's your plan? Don't tell me you plan to work alone—even if you're not afraid of death, I haven't lived long enough." Though her tone was cold and hard, the concern hidden in her words was unmistakable.

choices.text: Request Ye Qing's assistance, borrow the Demonic Path Fog
choices.description: Ye Qing's Demonic Path Fog can conceal the Tianji Record's aura, which is currently the only countermeasure. Even if it only buys him a few days, it's enough to refine the fake death plan.
choices.visible_reward: Gain three days of buffer time
choices.risk_hint: The fog's effect is limited, once the time expires he will still be exposed

text.content:
Ye Qing's expression became subtle.

She stared at Chen Ji for a long while, seemingly weighing something. After a long silence, she sighed softly and took out a pitch-black Jade Pendant from her bosom.

"The Demonic Path Fog is a secret technique of my Holy Sect," her voice was low, "if I give this to you... it's equivalent to betraying the Holy Sect. Do you know what this means?"

dialogue.content: "It means you have no turning back." Ye Qing stuffed the Jade Pendant into Chen Ji's hand, her voice suddenly becoming very light, "But it doesn't matter, since I long ago had no retreat. From the moment I chose to cooperate with you, my life was bound to yours." A self-mocking smile curved her lips, "Fate Twinborn... what an ironic concept."

choices.text: Activate the Tianji Record, foresee three days hence
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to examine the future three days hence, seeking the key to breaking the situation. Even if it costs Heavenly Fate, we must know where the variables of this tribulation lie.
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is inherently precious, and after consumption, one will be even more passive

text.content:
Chen Ji did not speak, merely slowly closing his eyes, probing his divine sense into the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace.

In that instant, an enigmatic and unfathomable power surged from the fragment, like countless delicate threads extending upstream along the river of time. Three breaths later, Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes—his face had paled somewhat, yet his eyes blazed with an unusual light.

"I saw it." His voice was soft, yet carried an indescribable certainty, "Three days later, the Demonic Path Commander will indeed activate the altar. But before that... he will first send someone to kill a person."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing's eyes widened slightly. She knew the Tianji Record had the power to foresee the future, but witnessing Chen Ji施展 it still made her heart palpitate with fear.

"Kill whom?" she pressed, her voice carrying an almost imperceptible tremor.

Chen Ji looked at her, a meaningful smile curving his lips: "Someone both you and I know—Su Qingyao."

text.content:
Ye Qing's expression instantly changed.

"Su Qingyao?" Her voice rose sharply, "That Inner Sect Senior Fellow from Tianqing Sect? How could you foresee her death?"

Chen Ji did not answer. His gaze越过 Ye Qing's shoulder, looking past the alley toward that brightly lit tavern. On the second-floor window of the tavern, a familiar figure stood in deep thought, gazing this way.

It was Su Qingyao.

At some point, she had actually appeared in the imperial capital.

Chen Ji's mind raced swiftly.

The Tianji Record's foresight told him that Su Qingyao would become the Demonic Path Commander's target because there existed a certain "Causal Link" between her and Chen Ji—and this link was precisely the key the Demonic Path Commander used to locate him.

As long as Su Qingyao lived, Chen Ji could never truly hide.

Therefore, the Demonic Path Commander chose to kill Su Qingyao first.

And Chen Ji... could never allow her to die.

dialogue.content:
"What do you plan to do?" Ye Qing's voice interrupted Chen Ji's thoughts, "Su Qingyao may be formidable, but she is only one person. If the Demonic Path wants to kill her, they will send at least three Transcendence Realm assassins or more. You cannot protect her and evade the altar's tracking simultaneously."

She paused, a complex emotion flickering in her eyes: "Unless... you are willing to let her know your true identity. A Su Qingyao who knows the truth will no longer be your weakness."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing proposed a crucial suggestion: let Su Qingyao know the truth, so she would not become the weakness the Demonic Path uses to locate Chen Ji. But this would mean Chen Ji's carefully maintained "waste genius persona" would completely collapse, and he would face all enemies with his true identity.

choices.text: Continue hiding, using her as bait
choices.description: Su Qingyao, unaware of the truth, will instead become the Demonic Path's greatest variable. Let the Demonic Path think she is merely an ordinary decoy, and Chen Ji can find counterattack opportunities within.
choices.visible_cost: Su Qingyao may fall into genuine danger
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the persona, scheme in the shadows
choices.risk_hint: If it fails, Su Qingyao will undoubtedly perish

text.content:
Ye Qing gazed at Chen Ji, an ineffable emotion flickering in her eyes.

"You are indeed ruthless enough." Her voice was soft, impossible to tell if it was sarcasm or admiration, "Using someone you care about as bait... such a thing, you proceed without hesitation."

Chen Ji did not deny it. He merely quietly watched the figure at that distant window, silently calculating each move of the chess game.

choices.text: Openly reveal and join forces with her
choices.description: Su Qingyao approached the truth three times only to have it dissolved; she is precisely the person most likely to see through Chen Ji. Since that is the case, why not take the initiative to confess, trading for a true ally.
choices.visible_reward: Gain a powerful ally, dissolve the causal link
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao might not believe, instead exposing even more

text.content:
Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, then softly shook her head.

"You have changed," her voice carried a faint trace of emotion, "The old you would never have made such a choice. It seems this Su Qingyao truly is different to you."

Chen Ji did not answer. He raised his head toward that window, just as Su Qingyao's gaze met his. Their eyes met, and he smiled faintly, making a gesture that said "come here."

choices.description: Not rush to expose the truth, but first observe Su Qingyao's purpose for coming. If she stands with Chen Ji, everything can be resolved; if she is an enemy, it would be perfect to use the Demonic Path's hand to eliminate this threat.
choices.visible_reward: Identify friend from foe, divide opponents

text.content: Ye Qing raised an eyebrow, seemingly surprised by Chen Ji's choice. "You're quite cautious," her voice carried a hint of playfulness, "but that's right too. In a situation like this, being cautious is never wrong. I'll take my leave first—three days later, regardless of what choice you make, I'll buy you some time." After saying this, her figure vanished like a ghost into the night, leaving only a faint, lingering fragrance.

At the alley entrance, Su Qingyao's figure had already vanished. A moment later, light footsteps sounded from behind. Chen Ji didn't turn around, merely waiting silently. The footsteps drew closer, finally stopping three feet behind him. "Chen Ji." Su Qingyao's voice was cold as frost, "I've been searching for you for a long time." She paused, as if weighing her words: "I have some questions for you. About you, about the Tianji Record... about what you've been hiding these three years." Her tone was calm, but Chen Ji could sense the hidden edge within it—the resolve of someone who had waited far too long, finally deciding to uncover the truth.

The night wind stirred Su Qingyao's hair, shimmering with a faint silver glow under the moonlight. Her eyes were firmly fixed on Chen Ji's back, as if wanting to capture every subtle movement of his. Three years of pursuit, three attempts to get close, three failures. She was fed up with being toyed with. Tonight, she would finally get her answer. And Chen Ji... seemed to have made some kind of decision at this moment. "You want to know the truth?" His voice was light, carrying an indecipherable tone, "That depends... on whether you're prepared to bear the weight of truth."

Chen Ji turned around slowly. Moonlight fell on his extremely ordinary face, yet at this moment revealed an entirely different aura—one no longer carrying the timidity and humility common to atrash disciple, but a steadiness gained through vicissitudes, a detachment born from seeing through worldly affairs. "Senior Sister Su," his voice was light but carried a strange power, "Do you know why, over these three years, every time you approached the truth, something would mysteriously interrupt?" Su Qingyao's eyes narrowed slightly, saying nothing. "Because that was intentional on my part." A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, "I was protecting you—or rather, protecting myself. Because as long as you don't know the truth, you won't become my weakness. And atrash with no weaknesses... is the target no one is willing to target." The alley was terrifyingly quiet, filled only with the howling night wind. Su Qingyao stared hard at Chen Ji, her eyes flickering with countless complex emotions—shock, anger, confusion, and a trace of... heartache she herself hadn't noticed.

After a long while, Su Qingyao spoke. "So all these three years... you carried everything alone?" Her voice was somewhat hoarse, "Being ridiculed by everyone, being looked down upon, being suppressed, being trampled... you endured all of it?" Chen Ji didn't answer. His gaze passed over Su Qingyao's shoulder, looking toward the brightly lit imperial city in the distance, a flash of weariness crossing the depths of his eyes. "None of that matters," his voice was very calm, "What matters is, now there's a group of people who want my life. And you, because of some causal connection between us, have also become their target." Su Qingyao's expression changed slightly. "In three days," Chen Ji looked at her, his expression unusually serious, "the Demonic Path will send someone to kill you. So, Senior Sister Su, I need you to make a choice—" His voice echoed in the night wind, carrying an unquestionable force: "Leave, and have nothing more to do with me from now on; or... stay, and fight shoulder to shoulder with me."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji had revealed his identity and laid his cards on the table with Su Qingyao. Now he needed to know Su Qingyao's choice—whether to leave this place of turmoil or fight alongside him.

choices.description: Su Qingyao chose to stay and fight shoulder to shoulder with Chen Ji against the coming crisis. She had been investigating for three years and could not give up at this moment.
choices.visible_cost: Get pulled into a greater maelstrom
choices.visible_reward: Gain a powerful ally, unlock the possibility of "Shared Fate"
choices.risk_hint: Life and death intertwined, success or failure shared

text.content: Su Qingyao remained silent for a moment. Moonlight fell upon her face, revealing the fleeting fluctuation in those cold eyes. She gazed at Chen Ji for a long, long time, as if trying to see through this man she had been tracking for three years. "Do you know what?" she suddenly spoke, her voice carrying a trace of self-mockery, "Over these three years, I've imagined countless times the scene when I would uncover your true face. I thought I would be furious, would be aggrieved, would want to tear you to pieces."

dialogue.content: She took a deep breath, the coldness in her eyes gradually fading, replaced by a softness she herself wasn't aware of. "But now that I'm truly standing here, I realized... I only want to ask you one thing." She stepped forward, closing the distance between herself and Chen Ji to less than a foot. She raised her head, her gaze burning as she stared at him: "During these three years, you, alone... weren't you tired?" Chen Ji was stunned. He had expected Su Qingyao to be angry, to question, to break apart—he had prepared himself for everything, but was utterly unprepared for this question.

choices.description: Su Qingyao chose to leave, but not to escape—rather, to help Chen Ji from the outside. She would return to the Tianqing Sect and do her best to delay the enemies' movements.

text.content: Su Qingyao fell silent. Her gaze fell on Chen Ji, complex and hard to read. The three-year chase had concluded tonight. She had wanted countless times to seize this "trash" by the throat, to expose his disguise, to make him lose face in front of everyone. But now that she truly had the answer, she found... she didn't want to see such a scene at all.

dialogue.content: "I'll return to the Tianqing Sect." she finally spoke, her voice regaining some of its coldness, but the concern within was utterly concealed, "The old Sect Master has been making frequent moves lately; I must keep watch on him. At the same time... I'll do my best to delay the Sect's interference in the imperial city." She paused, as if hesitating, before finally saying: "Chen Ji, this time... you must survive. Do you hear me?" With that, she turned and left, her figure quickly disappearing into the night. Yet her final words took root like a seed deep within Chen Ji's heart.

text.content: The alley returned to silence. Chen Ji stood alone beneath the moonlight, gazing in the direction Su Qingyao had departed. He could feel his heartbeat was faster than usual, a strange sensation—he hadn't experienced this in so long. Three years. For three years, he had made himself like a stone, without desires, cold-hearted. He thought his heart would no longer stir, but tonight... "Su Qingyao..." he murmured her name, an involuntary faint smile curving his lips, "What a troublesome woman indeed." Yet in the depths of his eyes, a warmth he hadn't felt in ages was quietly emerging.

However, the warmth lasted only a moment before being replaced by a chill.

Chen Ji's gaze suddenly turned sharp. He sensed it—the moment Su Qingyao left, another gaze swept over him.

That gaze was different from the previous hidden stare. This one was colder, more lofty, as if an invisible pair of eyes was gazing down at him from the endless Void, wanting to see through everything about him.

Heavenly Eyes.

Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. He knew that his use of the Tianji Record to peer into the future had been noticed by that existence that transcended all.

And this... was merely the beginning.

When Ye Qing's figure vanished into the night, Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand—he knew that time was running out.

The cross-realm pursuit of the Demonic Path commander was closing in, the gaze of the Heavenly Eyes had descended, Su Qingyao had become a target due to the causal connection, and the sacrifice at the Fate Altar three days later hung like a sharp sword over his head.

The feigned death plan had to be accelerated.

Otherwise, what awaited him would be a lethal trap.

Chen Ji took a deep breath and turned, disappearing into the night of the imperial capital. The commotion of the capital faded behind him, but the chessboard of destiny quietly accelerated its rotation—at this very moment. And what he didn't know was that a pair of eyes that had long been watching him were revealing a meaningful smile in the shadows.
